purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Labé

queries.query: Labé Guinea official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS map
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Guinea's official Ministry of Mines and Geology cadastre ArcGIS portal and a Labé-specific cadastral map/document lead. The public service directory was reachable, but the application layer and parcel layer requests required a token; no bounded anonymous parcel response was exposed.

queries.query: Labé Guinée cadastre parcelles registre foncier carte officielle
queries.result: First-party French discovery identified the official Guinea cadastre portal, the official title-registration procedure, and a Labé cadastral section/map reference in a World Bank-hosted Guinea project document. The search did not expose a public anonymous parcel API or safe parcel geometry download.

registryEvidence: The official Guinea cadastre host at cadastre.mines.gov.gn exposes an ArcGIS REST service directory, and the Labé-specific cadastral document identifies the Section Domaines et Cadastre of the Direction Préfectorale de l'Urbanisme, de l'Habitat et de la Construction de Labé as the local cadastral custodian. This establishes a local registry/map lead, not open parcel-data admission.

officialSources.observation: Official Ministry of Mines and Geology cadastre ArcGIS REST directory responded with public service names including Landfolio GP services and SSRSMaps_SOE. No parcel layer was exposed in this directory response.
Official Guinea cadastre map application-layer endpoint is indexed, but direct REST metadata requests returned token-required errors.

Official Guinea public-service procedure states that a person or entity may seek a land-title registration and directs the application to the commune mayor and the Director General of Land Conservation; this is procedure evidence, not parcel geometry.

World Bank-hosted Guinea project document contains a Labé cadastral situation-plan reference, Livre Foncier de Labé, and names the local Section Domaines et Cadastre; it is retained as documentary custodian evidence, not as a parcel dataset.

source: Guinea Ministry of Mines and Geology cadastre ArcGIS portal / Labé Section Domaines et Cadastre (public map lead; anonymous parcel access not verified)

requestOutcomes.outcome: TLS-verified request returned HTTP 200 and a 319-byte JSON service directory. It listed ExportWebMap, LandfolioGPServicev2_1_1, LandfolioGPServicev4_0_0, and SSRSMaps_SOE; no parcel schema or geometry was returned.
TLS-verified request returned HTTP 200 with ArcGIS error code 499, Token Required. No login, token acquisition, or bypass was attempted.
TLS-verified request returned HTTP 200 with ArcGIS error code 499, Token Required; layer schema and CRS unavailable.
TLS-verified request returned HTTP 200 with ArcGIS error code 499, Token Required; no layer fields, native IDs, or geometry returned.
TLS-verified request returned HTTP 500 HTML error; no portal item/configuration response was available.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Guinea national cadastre portal with a Labé local cadastral custodian and Labé-specific documentary map evidence.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official cadastre service directory and local Labé custodian are evidenced, but no anonymous bounded ID+geometry response, source schema, CRS, or citywide parcel coverage was verified.

remainingUncertainty: The official map application may expose parcel data to an authorized interactive client, but the current public configuration and token-gated layer schema could not be inspected anonymously. The exact WUP point was preserved and not used as an absence test. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, or unsafe fields were requested or retained; no TLS exception was used. No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe native parcel identity and full polygon were observed. This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
